tagline: Schedule code review meetings from PRs and post summaries back to issues
metaTitle: GitHub + Zoom Integration: Code Review Meetings from PRs
metaDescription: Settle tricky pull requests face to face. GAIA schedules a Zoom code review from PR comments and files action items as issues. See the setup steps.
keywords: schedule code review meeting from GitHub
post Zoom meeting notes to GitHub
intro:
Code reviews that require synchronous discussion are a common bottleneck in engineering workflows. A reviewer leaves a complex comment on a GitHub PR, the developer responds in a thread, and the back-and-forth takes days to resolve what a ten-minute Zoom call could address immediately. But scheduling that call requires leaving the PR, opening a calendar, finding available time, creating a meeting link, and sharing it — a process that rarely happens quickly enough to prevent the PR from stalling.

GAIA links PR threads to video meetings to make synchronous code review as easy as leaving a comment. A developer or reviewer can ask GAIA to schedule a code review meeting directly from a PR comment, and GAIA will find available time, create the meeting, and post the link back to the PR thread typically within a minute. After the meeting ends, GAIA posts a summary of the discussion back to the issue or PR as a comment, creating a permanent record of decisions made without anyone having to manually document the call.

This is valuable for distributed engineering teams where asynchronous code review occasionally requires a quick sync, for engineering managers who want all architectural decisions documented in GitHub regardless of how they were made, and for any team that wants to reduce the friction between async and sync collaboration in their development workflow.

useCases.title: Schedule code review meetings from PR comments
useCases.description: When a developer comments '@gaia schedule review meeting' on a pull request, GAIA checks participants' calendars, finds the next available slot, creates a video meeting, and posts the join link back to the PR thread, all typically within a minute.

useCases.title: Post Zoom meeting summaries to GitHub issues
useCases.description: After a code review or architectural discussion concludes, GAIA generates a meeting summary and posts it as a comment on the linked issue or PR, creating a searchable record of decisions, action items, and open questions without manual note-taking.

useCases.title: Create GitHub issues from Zoom meeting action items
useCases.description: GAIA analyzes meeting transcripts for action items and automatically creates corresponding issues with the right labels and assignees so follow-up work from technical discussions is always captured in the backlog.

useCases.title: Notify PR participants when a review meeting is scheduled
useCases.description: When a meeting is scheduled for a specific PR, GAIA automatically notifies all PR participants (author, reviewers, and commenters) via a comment on the PR and email so no one misses the synchronous discussion.

useCases.title: Schedule sprint planning and retrospective meetings from milestones
useCases.description: GAIA can schedule recurring meetings for sprint planning and retrospectives based on milestone cadence, automatically linking the meeting agenda to the milestone's open and closed issues for a structured engineering rhythm.

howItWorks.step: Connect GitHub and Zoom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your GitHub and Zoom accounts in GAIA's integrations panel. GAIA will request calendar access to find available meeting slots and API access to create and manage meetings on your behalf.

Set default meeting durations for different types of reviews, specify which repositories should have meeting scheduling enabled, configure how summaries should be formatted, and choose whether GAIA should automatically transcribe meetings.

howItWorks.step: GAIA connects your code discussions with synchronous meetings
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors PR threads for scheduling requests and watches for completed meetings, handling scheduling, notifications, and post-meeting documentation automatically. All your technical discussions end up documented on the PR or issue where future contributors can find them.

faqs.question: Does GAIA automatically transcribe Zoom meetings about code reviews?
faqs.answer: GAIA can use the built-in transcription feature (available on paid plans) to generate meeting summaries. If transcription is not available, GAIA creates a structured summary template for the meeting host to fill in, then posts it to the PR or issue on their behalf.

faqs.question: Can GAIA schedule meetings with participants across different time zones?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA checks the Google Calendar or Outlook availability of all PR participants and proposes meeting times that work across time zones, presenting options in each participant's local time to avoid scheduling confusion.

faqs.question: What if I want to schedule a meeting without connecting it to a GitHub issue?
faqs.answer: GAIA can schedule video meetings independently of any repository at any time through its conversational interface. This integration is an additional layer that connects meetings to specific PRs and issues when that context is relevant.
